title: LA Colossal – Ru-Guan 05 (Seated)
prompt:
Fine art body painting photography. Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Japanese woman in her early 20s, black hair in two low braids, natural face with a playful smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the bench, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Ru-Guan celadon body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface. The body painting is the only covering on the body — no garments, no fabric, no robes, no bodysuit, no leggings, no stockings. High-gloss deep saturated sky-blue glaze clearly different from skin, with a fine dense crackle of thin dark lines and golden secondary crackle, no painted motifs, not kintsugi. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully glazed and crackled.

Pose: Seated on a low wooden bench, leaning back slightly with both hands planted behind her, chest open and belly relaxed forward, legs crossed at the knee. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch sky-blue crackle-glazed platform stiletto thong sandals with a slim ankle strap.
Nails: Extra long oval nails, sky blue.

Background & Lighting: Minimal white gallery with pale plinths, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Soft high-key light with raking side light, strong contrast against white. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
